messages:
anya: Heads up: latency SLO breaches started at 09:12 UTC on prod/gpu-pool-7. Saw 99p jump to ~420ms and throughput down ~30%.
sam: same here — dashboards show KV cache hit-rate collapsed from 92% -> 18% exactly at 09:11:40.
raj: Is this after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout? flag: runtime.kernel_selector=v2 enabled at 08:50.
anya: yes. Also changed batching heuristics (batcher.dynamic_shard=true) in the same deploy. Could be an interaction.
dmitri: grabbed a flamegraph from worker-3 — noisy spikes in eviction path. snippet:
```
evict_prefix_locked -> populate_shard -> compute_costs (hot)
alloc_prefix_entry -> memcpy -> rehash_key
```
lisa: saw high prefix key churn from tenant t-98765, QPS spiked ~6x. noisy neighbor looks likely.
sam: kernel v2 added model_variant to prefix key serialization — could increase cardinality.
anya: that plus the batching change reducing batch size would reduce cache reuse.
ci-bot: deploy:runtime:v2026.03 rolled by @eng-release at 08:49 UTC — http://deploy/log/1234
raj: immediate mitigation options: rollback kernel_selector v2 or flip batcher.dynamic_shard=false. flipping batching first.
dmitri: temp proposal: increase KV shard count for pool-7 by 4 to reduce eviction pressure (will rebalance).
lisa: rebalance causes CPU burst, ok but maybe just throttle tenant t-98765 to 50rps for quick relief.
anya: applying tenant throttle and toggling batcher.dynamic_shard=false now.
ops-bot: throttle applied: tenant=t-98765 limit=50rps by @anya at 09:18 UTC :white_check_mark:
sam: after throttle + batching toggle, hit-rate up to 61% and p99 latency down to ~160ms. :relieved:
lisa: long-term fixes: remove model_variant from prefix key, add canonicalization + stable hashing.
anya: I'll open ticket ENGRT-2241 with pprof dumps, flamegraphs, diffs. scheduling rollback window if needed.
dmitri: attaching note to ticket: flamegraphs, pprof gz, kernel-v2 diff, batching-change patch, tenant traces.
anya: thanks all — keeping thread open for follow-ups. :eyes:
